snippet.title: Gavin Newsom's Wife Caught Making Millions From A Fake Charity
snippet.description:
While California families struggle to pay for basic groceries, the governor's wife is quietly accumulating a multi-million dollar fortune through a shady nonprofit. How can anyone look at this paper trail and still pretend our political system isn’t completely rotten to the core?

snippet.title: 101 Free Government and Nonprofit Services Americans Keep Ignoring
snippet.description:
101 Free Government and Nonprofit Services Americans Keep Ignoring
Did you know the government is legally required to give you free credit reports every week? Or that there are hospitals that must treat you for free by law? Or that billions in Pell Grants go unclaimed because students skip a free form?

This video reveals 101 free government and nonprofit services that most Americans are completely ignoring. Programs for healthcare, housing, food, education, legal help, job training, childcare, veterans, seniors, and more.

No gimmicks. No hidden fees. Just 101 real services that are free and available right now.

Comment below: what free service did YOU not know about before watching this?

snippet.title: Court dismisses Elon Musk's case against Sam Altman and OpenAI
snippet.description: JUST IN: A court ruled in favor of OpenAI and its chief executive, Sam Altman, in a lawsuit brought by Elon Musk over alleged misconduct in the company's evolution from a non-profit upstart to a for-profit corporation.
